===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Allwinner]] D1 @1.0GHz (64-bit) :Single-core ''XuanTie'' C906 ([https://occ.t-head.cn/vendor/cpu/index?id=3817197695983423488 RISC-V]) *Storage: 256MB (SPI NAND) Flash, :TF card (max.128GB)/MMC card slot *Memory: 512GB (DDR3) SDRAM ([[SK hynix]]) *Wi-Fi: [[XRadio]] [http://www.xradiotech.com/product/XR829.php XR829] :802.11bgn (1T1R), BT 4.0 *USB: 1x USB 2.0 port *GPIO: 1x 40-pin headers *Power Source: USB (Type-C) port
